en: Hetuduka, Saṅkiliṭṭhattika (The Dyad on Roots, The Triad on the Corrupt)

Conditioned by a state that is neither a root nor defiled-defiling, a state that is a root and defiled-defiling arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

In dependence on a state that is neither a root nor not-defiled-defiling, a state that is neither a root nor defiled-defiling arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root, three under predominance; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a state that is not a root, not defiled, and not subject to defilement, a state that is a root, not defiled, and not subject to defilement arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root [condition] there are three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance [condition] there are three.
